# USCM 'Lucky Thirteen'
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the unit's lore primer.
[italic]The United States Colonial Marines (USCM) 4th Division, 13th Strike Group, 13th Regiment, known as the "Lucky Thirteen", is a Colonial Marine expeditionary force formed to patrol the outer colonies for threats to the United Americas. The Lucky Thirteen is composed primarily of reservists and B-rate troops drawn from the inner UA colonies following the Tychon Tackle. They have been deployed to the Neroid Sector to bolster the United Americas response to the growing number of insurgencies.[/italic]
